scope: Validate target-specific column binding, not cryptographic strength
input: Four existing anonymous trace files, checksum verified
transformation: Cyclically rotate all 48 observed columns left by one; preserve all values and boundaries
inference: Unmodified recover.py receives only five rotated training rows
positive: Returned order must equal old order translated into new coordinates; extracted history must match on every held-out row
negative: Unchanged old order must fail at least one held-out row in every variant
budget: One pass over four stored traces, 60 seconds
limitations: Family-aware trace test; no Wasm extraction, no new obfuscation, no independent decoder or attack-comparison claim
